GPS speed well below what pod power should give: weed on rudder, extra drag, or adverse current

arguments.message: shaft power well under critical power for a minute
1200 m to go: decide when to start the finish

arguments.text: Plan (1 min): 8 km, 8 legs of 1 km. Steer by the pod (shaft power, w_bal_pod_frac); boat-speed reserve mixes in current/drag. Target shaft power about sustainable_shaft_power_w (~170 W, CP shaft 165). Start was hard (232 W). Let them settle; cue only if still well above sustainable after minute 2-3. Watches set: pod_reserve_low, drag_or_current (push_local below -0.2 for 30 s: check rudder/weed vs current; on out-and-back, current flips each leg), effort_sag, final_push_window at 1200 m. CP may be 10-25 pct off: check cp_implied later.

text: no cue: hard start is expected and still in the first minute; set four watches and a plan note
no cue: settled at 174 W shaft against 170 W sustainable, pace on target, no current yet

arguments.text: Ease a touch, current helps here. Save it for the return.

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w - sustainable_shaft_power_w > 12 and elapsed_s > 300 and remaining_m > 1500
arguments.message: shaft power more than 12 W above sustainable for 90 s

arguments.text: 7 min, 1350 m, leg 2 (heading south) has helping current +0.1 m/s. Shaft 177 vs sustainable 169, pod reserve 44 pct: cued ease (no pace target) to save effort on the helping leg; plan to hold or push slightly on legs against the current (odd legs north seemed slightly adverse, -0.05). Added watch overspend (shaft more than 12 W over sustainable for 90 s).

text: cued ease: shaft 8 W over sustainable on a leg where the current helps, so the saving costs least here

arguments.text: After the turn, push gently into the current, pace 2:45.

10 min, 1925 m: ease worked (shaft 177 to 163 on helping leg 2). Cued push with ground pace 165 s/500 for leg 3 north into about -0.1 m/s current (estimate: about 176 W shaft, 7 W over sustainable). On next south leg, ease back to about 163-165 W shaft. Keep the pod reserve on track to reach about 0 at the finish.

text: cued gentle push at 2:45 ground pace for the leg into the current, where extra effort buys the most time

arguments.text: Too hot. Ease back to steady race effort, 2:42.

13 min, 2495 m, leg 3 north: push cue OVERSHOT: shaft 198 W (sustainable 169), ground pace 155 not the 165 asked; pod reserve 35 pct. Cued ease with ground pace 162. Boat-speed reserve (15 pct) is unreliable: push_along model says -0.1 on this leg but GPS vs pod (push_local) said +0.1 then about 0, so the current is not a simple flip; trust w_bal_pod_frac. Lesson: this paddler overreacts to push; prefer hold with a pace target, avoid push.

text: cued ease to 2:42: the push cue overshot to 198 W shaft, 29 W above sustainable, pod reserve draining

arguments.message: pod reserve below 12 pct with more than 1.5 km left

arguments.text: 14.1 min, 2697 m: pod reserve fell to 23.5 pct after push overshoot (peak shaft 206 W at 18.7 min data). Ease cue at 13.1 is working: 30-s shaft mean falling 206 to 192 and dropping, ground pace 156 to 159 (target 162). No new cue. Pod reserve watch moved to 12 pct. From here the budget is tight: about 166-168 W shaft to the finish, no more pushes; use hold with a pace target if needed.

text: no cue: the ease cue is already taking effect (shaft power falling, pace easing toward 2:42); lowered the reserve alarm to 12 pct
no cue: overspend alert lags the ease already under way (30-s shaft mean down to 191 and falling)

arguments.text: Reserve almost gone. Ease off this leg and recover.

15.6 min, 2990 m, turn into leg 4 (south): shaft back up to 197 W for 3 min despite ease cue at 13.1 (ease did not stick); pod reserve 10 pct, no fade yet (speed vs early race +2). Cued firm ease, ground pace 163. Paddler says effort 3/10, plenty left. Suspicion: critical power may be set too low (test can be 10-25 pct off). Test before changing: if pod reserve reads near 0 and shaft stays above 175 W with no fade for several minutes, raise cp_shaft (try about 185). If speed fades, they are truly empty: ease harder.

arguments.message: pod reserve reads empty yet shaft above 175 W for 2 min: check fade, consider raising critical power

text: cued firm ease to 2:43 on the helping leg: pod reserve at 10 pct with 5 km left; paddler says 3/10, so watching whether critical power is set too low
